blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)往往无法在两个图像上匹配一个点或一个对象,即使答案可以从自己的隐藏状态解码. 我们从视觉符号追踪到答题字母的这个失败,在Qune3-VL(2B-32B),InternVL3.5-8B,和Gemma-3-12B中,关于合成形状相匹配,同心点相通(HPatches),和语义相通(SPair-71k),并找到两个截然不同的出题点,一组带比较的注意头,以及一个能触及0.02%参数的修复. 两个出错点: 准确的拷贝被比较,但没有被读出. 答案-位置探测器在每一个家族中都超过了被校正的输出15到25分,因为可名和不可名的形状相同,沿着探测器的方向向下行走的答案不超过随机方向. 语义上的信件在视觉符号中存在,但从未到达答案. 一条途径:将16-32个头的交叉图像注意力再分配,并保留其质量,取出17-22分的合成精度和15-32分的HPatches精度,对随机或注意相匹配的头最多取出7分. 训练本身发现的杠杆:只有这些头的查询和关键预测才能使SPair-71k的精度提高28.3分(Qune3-VL-8B)和25.1分(InternVL3.5-8B),击败了两层相配和注意力相配的头,并转至HPatches和BLINK. 一个不受约束的全层适配器通过相同头部的注意途径其收益的21-51%,随机头部最多为7%,通过改变其读取内容(效果的83-86%)而不是其重量来完成. 每个决定规则在运行前被冻结,每个被报告的数字由独立核查脚本重编.

blocks.en: Vision–language models (VLMs) answer open-ended questions about images, yet remain unreliable when a task requires matching a point, a shape, or an object across two images ( Fu et al., 2024 ) . Many such failures do not originate in the vision encoder. VLMs underperform direct readouts of their own encoders on vision-centric tasks ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ; image value tokens inside the language model support semantic correspondence zero-shot even when the model’s answer is wrong ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; counting fails even when numerical information remains linearly separable ( Pang et al., 2026 ) ; and visual evidence can be encoded about as strongly when the answer is wrong as when it is right ( Nooralahzadeh et al., 2026 ) . VLMs often see more than they say .
blocks.zh: Vision - 语言模型(VLMs)回答了关于图像的开放式问题,然而当任务需要匹配一个点,一个形状,或者一个跨越两个图像的物体(Fu等人,2024年)时仍然不可靠. 许多这种失败并非源于视觉编码器。 VLM在以视觉为中心的任务上直接读取了自己的编码器(Fu等,2025年;语言模型内部的图像值符号支持语义函式零发(Liu等,2025年);即使数字信息仍可线性分离(Pang等,2026年;可像正确时一样强烈地编码出视觉证据(Noorahzadeh等,2026年)). VLM往往比他们所说的更多。

blocks.en: For cross-image correspondence, Shahgir et al. (2026) argue that this gap is widest for entities without names: on synthetic “squiggle” correspondence, Qwen3-VL-2B answers 29.0% correctly while a representation probe over its hidden states reaches 74.2%, and teaching arbitrary names narrows the gap. That readout compares hidden states at the annotated locations of the reference and the options, which the answering model must find itself. Such numbers are useful upper references, but they do not measure an input-matched gap, and they do not say where inside the language model the information is lost, nor what would recover it.
blocks.zh: Shahgir等人(2026年)认为,对于没有名字的实体来说,这一差距是最大的:在合成的“quiggle”信件中,Qune3-VL-2B正确回答29.0%,而对其隐藏状态的描述调查则达到74.2%,教授任意名称缩小了差距。 该读取比较了注释引用位置的隐藏状态和答案模型必须找到的选项。 这类数字是有用的上行引用,但是它们没有测量输入相匹配的缺口,也没有说明信息在语言模型内丢失的地方,也没有说明会恢复什么.

blocks.en: Open VLMs encode each image independently, so cross-image comparison must be computed inside the language model ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . This makes the comparison a concrete, localizable computation: tokens of the second image must retrieve evidence from the first through attention. We follow the signal along this path (Fig. 1 ). We measure what is available at each stage with probes that receive only what the model receives, and compare every gap against a calibrated output. We then localize the components that carry the comparison, characterize what they attend to, and test the localization by repairing it: we train only these components, compare them against matched alternatives, and ask, through attention transplantation, whether unconstrained training discovers the same components on its own. Decision rules for every run were frozen in advance; the main claims are confirmed on fresh items.
blocks.zh: Open VLMs独立地将每个图像编码,所以跨图像比较必须在语言模型内部计算(Wang等,2026). 这使得比较成为具体,可分解的计算:第二幅图像的标志必须通过注意从第一幅取出证据. 我们沿着这条路走(图1)。 我们用只接收模型所得的探测器来衡量每个阶段的可用情况,并将每个缺口与校准输出进行比较。 然后我们将带比较的组件本地化, 描述它们所处理的, 通过修复来测试本地化: 我们只训练这些组件, 将它们与匹配的替代品进行比较, 通过注意力移植, 询问不受约束的训练是否自己发现相同的组件。 每次运行的决定规则都事先被冻结;主要索赔要求得到确认。

blocks.en: Locating the loss matters because different loci call for different remedies. If the answer is computed but not emitted, a remedy must act on how the output reads it; if the information never reaches the answer position, no change to the output side can help, and the computation that brings it there must change instead. We find both cases, in different tasks, inside the same models.
blocks.zh: 确定损失的归属很重要,因为不同的地方需要不同的补救办法。 如果答案是计算出来的,但没有释放出来,则必须对输出读取它的方式进行补救;如果信息从未到达答案位置,输出方的任何变化都无济于事,而输出方的计算必须改变。 我们发现这两种情况,在不同的任务中,在同一模式中。

blocks.en: The comparison between two images runs through a small, identifiable pathway: 16–32 attention heads through which tokens of the second image retrieve evidence from the first. We establish this pathway with four kinds of evidence that do not depend on each other. Causal role : redistributing the heads’ cross-image attention with its mass preserved removes 15 15 – 32 ​ p ​ p 32\,pp of synthetic and same-instance accuracy, also on the items whose residual states stay in distribution, while random and attention-matched heads remove at most 7 ​ p ​ p 7\,pp . Specificity : the heads’ attention is selective for the reference, gated by its salience, and predicts on fresh items whether the comparison reaches the answer position. Sufficiency as a lever : training only their query and key projections recovers most of the semantic-correspondence deficit ( + 25 +25 to + 28 ​ p ​ p +28\,pp ) and beats heads matched in layer or in attention mass. Convergence : an adapter that may change every layer routes a third to a half of its gain through the same heads in Qwen3-VL-8B , by changing what they read; training other heads matched in attention mass raises the selectivity of these heads as well, and selectivity tracks accuracy across all fourteen trained models. The exact-copy failure, by contrast, lies downstream of this pathway: the comparison is computed and decodable at the answer position, yet the output does not read it, and the model’s own letter directions at that position, unlike the probe’s, move the answer.
blocks.zh: 两个图像之间的比较贯穿一个小的,可识别的路径:16-32个注意头,第二个图像的标志通过它从第一个图像取出证据。 我们用四种不依赖于彼此的证据来建立这条道路。 原因作用:将头部的相像注意力与质量保存再分配去去掉15 15 — 32 p 32\pp的合成和同声精度,同样去掉那些残留状态仍在分布的物品,而随机和相相相配的相像头最多去掉7 p 7\pp. 具体性:头部的注意力是选择性的,以它的显著性为中心,并预测新项目比较是否达到答案位置。 作为杠杆的充足性:只训练他们的查询和关键预测恢复了大部分语义-对应性缺陷(+25+25到+28p+28\,pp),并用分层或注意质量来打头. Convertation:一个可改变每层三分之一到一半收益的适配器,通过Qune3-VL-8B中相同的头部,改变它们读取的内容;训练其他与注意力质量相匹配的头部也提高了这些头部的选择性,以及在所有14个训练过的模型中选择性跟踪精度. 相比之下,准确的复制失败位于这一路径的下游:比较在答案位置上是计算和可解码的,然而输出却不读取,模型在那个位置上的字母方向与探测器不同的是移动答案。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A measurement that separates seeing, comparing, and saying. Input-matched probes and a calibrated output baseline show that annotated-region readouts on synthetic matching measure pixel identity, and that the gap left after calibration is the same for unnameable and nameable shapes (§ 4.1 ). • Two distinct failure points in the same models , consistent across three families: exact copies are compared but not read out; semantic correspondences are present in visual tokens but do not reach the answer position (§ 4.2 – 4.3 ). • The cross-image comparison pathway. A small set of heads whose attention is causal for exact-copy and same-instance correspondence under mass-preserving knockouts, also on the items whose residual states stay in the natural range, beyond random and attention-matched heads, and which the base model does not yet use for semantic correspondence—the gap that repair closes. Their salience-gated, content-weighted selectivity predicts on fresh items whether the comparison reaches the answer position (§ 5 ). • A repair at 0.02 % 0.02\% of the parameters, on a pathway that fine-tuning finds on its own. Training only these heads’ query–key projections recovers most of the semantic-correspondence deficit and transfers to benchmarks never used for training. Attention transplantation and its decomposition show that an unconstrained adapter routes part of its gain through the same heads by a different mechanism—changing what they read rather than how they compare—so two independent routes to repair converge on one set of heads, a sufficient but redundant pathway (§ 6 ). • A verifiable protocol. Every run has frozen decision rules, every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts, and all outcomes, supported or not, are listed (Appendix A , Appendix G ); Table 7 maps each claim to its evidence and controls.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 一种能分辨、比较和表达的衡量方法。 输入相匹配的探测器和可校正的输出基线显示,关于合成相匹配度像素身份的注释区域读取,而校正后留下的空白对于无法命名和可命名的形状是相同的(§ 4.1). ^ 同一个模型中有两个明显的出错点,三个家族之间是一致的:准确的拷贝被比较但没有被读出;语义学的函文在视觉符号中存在,但没有达到答案位置(§4.2–4.3.). ^ . 跨图像比较路径. 一组小头,它们的注意力在质量保全击打下的精确复制和同声通信中是因果的,对于其残留状态停留在自然范围,超出随机和注意相匹配的头部,而基数模型尚未用于语义通信——修复的缺口会收缩. 他们的突出的、内容加权的选择性预测了新项目是否达到答案位置(§ 5) 。 只有培训这些负责人的询问 -- -- 关键预测能够弥补大部分语义和对应性缺陷,并转到从未用于培训的基准。 注意移植及其分解表明,一个不受约束的适配器通过一个不同的机制——改变它们读取的内容而不是它们如何比较——通过同一个头的部分收益,因此,修复的两个独立路线汇合在一组头上,一个足够但多余的路径(第6节)。 每一次运行都有被冻结的决定规则,每报告的数字由独立的核查脚本来重算,所有支持或不支持的结果都列出(附录A,附录G;表7绘制了每一份声称其证据和控制的地图.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Benchmarks expose VLM failures on perception tasks that are easy for humans, including visual and semantic correspondence ( Fu et al., 2024 ) . Fu et al. (2025) show that encoder readouts outperform the VLM on vision-centric tasks and attribute the bottleneck to the language model’s use of visual information. Liu et al. (2025) find that image value tokens inside the language model support segmentation and semantic correspondence zero-shot and that correct perceptual information is often present but not surfaced. Pang et al. (2026) place the counting bottleneck in the mapping to number tokens, and Veikherman et al. (2026) bound how often errors are encoded but unused. Shahgir et al. (2026) link the gap to nameability, and SOCO reports a similar asymmetry between visual and textual queries on real images ( Sunagad et al., 2026 ) ; Qiu et al. (2026) find that VLM judgments of visual sameness rely on semantic labels. We measure the gap with input-matched probes, find that it is not specific to unnameable entities, and identify the computation step at which it arises.
blocks.zh: 基准暴露出VLM在感知任务上的失败,这些任务对人类来说是容易的,包括视觉和语义通信(Fu等,2024. Fu等人(2025年)表明,编码器的读取量超过了以视觉为中心的任务的VLM,并将瓶颈归因于语言模型对视觉信息的使用. 刘等 (2025年)发现,语言模型内部的图像值符支持分解和语义函式零发,正确的知觉信息经常存在但并未浮出水面. Pang等 (2026年)将计数瓶颈放入了映射到数字符号上,而Veikherman等 (2026年)则将错误被编码到多少次但没有使用. Shahgir等人(2026年)将差距与可命名性联系起来,而SOCO报告在真实图像上的视觉和文字查询存在类似的不对称(Sunagad等,2026年;邱等. (2026)发现视觉等同性的VLM判断依赖于语义标签. 我们用输入匹配的探测器测量差距,发现它不是针对无法命名的实体的,并找出其产生的计算步骤.

blocks.en: Probe accuracy must be read against control tasks ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) , and decodability differences across layers do not add up to information lost ( Xu et al., 2020 ) . In text-only models, hidden-state probes can recover answers when sequence scoring collapses because of output biases ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , so a gap that output calibration closes is not evidence of a deeper failure. In VLMs, probe decodability and steering recovery can overstate grounding unless the image is ablated ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . We report every gap against a calibrated output and include image-ablation controls.
blocks.zh: 探测精度必须对照控制任务来读取(Hewitt和Liang,2019),分层可解码性差异不等于丢失信息(徐等,2020). 在只使用文本的模型中,隐藏状态探测器可以在序列分数倒闭时因输出偏差而恢复答案(Yan等,2026年),因此输出校正关闭的缺口并不是更深的失败的证据. 在VLMs中,探测器可解码和取回方向盘可以过度地描述地层,除非图像被消散(廖等,2026.). 我们对照一个校准的输出报告每个缺口,并包括图像放大控制。

blocks.en: Activation patching and mediation analysis ( Vig et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) have located where visual evidence gains or loses influence in single-image settings: arbitration between percept and prior ( Nooralahzadeh et al., 2026 ) , heads through which priors override vision ( Lietzow et al., 2026 ) , object localization ( Schaumlöffel et al., 2026 ) , and visual entities resolved too late for factual recall ( Venhoff et al., 2025 ; Biran et al., 2024 ) . Specialized heads ground text to image regions ( Park et al., 2026 ) , retrieve evidence in long multimodal contexts ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and, in Qwen3-VL-8B , track the region being described, so that redirecting their attention steers the description ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) . Multiple-choice answering involves symbol-producing heads ( Wiegreffe et al., 2025 ) and a decide-then-bind sequence ( Wong et al., 2026 ) . These studies concern text-to-image or within-image computation; we study region-to-region comparison between two images. Interventions have known artifacts: conclusions depend on the counterfactual and metric ( Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) , subspace patching can activate dormant pathways ( Makelov et al., 2024 ) , patched states can leave the natural distribution ( Grant et al., 2026 ) , and mid-layer interventions in VLMs can yield null results ( Zhang, 2026 ) . We pair each intervention with random-component controls and a residual-norm check.

blocks.en: Every item is a four-way multiple-choice question over two images: image 1 contains a location labelled ref ; image 2 contains four candidates labelled A–D, one of which corresponds to ref . In Syn -squiggle, shapes are closed cubic splines through n = 30 n{=}30 anchors; Syn -known uses ten nameable outline classes matched in size and stroke. In both, image 2 contains the same four shapes as image 1 at new positions, identical up to translation, so every option has a copy in image 1 and only ref -specific comparison solves the task; within-item shape pairs are separated by a minimum Chamfer distance. HP is same-instance point correspondence generated from HPatches homographies ( Balntas et al., 2017 ) ; SP is semantic keypoint correspondence from SPair-71k ( Min et al., 2019 ) . Distractors are at least 8% of the image diagonal from the target and from each other. Splits are by seed range ( Syn ), sequence ( HP ), or official split ( SP ), with 1,000 development and 1,000 test items per task (500 each for Syn -known) unless stated. For transfer we also evaluate the BLINK semantic- and visual-correspondence validation splits ( Fu et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en: To test whether the output uses the answer-position signal, we edit the residual stream at the answer position, at the probe’s layer, along the probe’s own three-dimensional subspace S S : we remove it or scale it by γ ∈ { 2 , 4 } \gamma\in\{2,4\} , and compare against 20 random subspaces matched in edit magnitude. No label information enters the edit, and the rules were frozen in advance. Neither edit moves the answer. On Syn -squiggle and on HP , in both Qwen3-VL-8B and InternVL3.5-8B , R 4 R_{4} changes by at most 0.2 ​ p ​ p 0.2\,pp , within the range of the random subspaces, and residual norms stay in the natural band (Appendix E ). The layer itself is not inert. Adding, at the same position and layer, the output direction of a letter the model did not choose switches the answer to that letter on 2.8 2.8 – 3.8 % 3.8\% of Syn and 9.6 9.6 – 18.6 % 18.6\% of HP items at eight times the probe subspace’s natural scale, against at most 0.4 % 0.4\% and 1.8 % 1.8\% for ten random directions of equal norm. Steering along the probe’s own class direction, toward a class it did not predict, moves at most 1.6 % 1.6\% of the items, within the range of the random directions (Appendix F ). The answer that the probe reads at the answer position is thus not the one the model reports. On HP , where the output is mostly correct, the model computes it through other channels; on Syn , the decodable comparison signal sits beside the output path and is not read out, in line with reports that decodable signals in VLMs need not be causal for the answer ( Zhang, 2026 ; Veikherman et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: 6  Repairing the Comparison

blocks.en: If the cross-image heads limit semantic correspondence, changing what they compare should help, and should help more than changing other components of similar size. blocks.en: All arms share one recipe and differ only in their trainable parameters, with base weights frozen. blocks.en: The arm-level pattern in Fig. 3 a was observed after the fact. We tested it with rules frozen before any data. For a trained arm with gain g g over the base model, we manipulate only the post-softmax attention rows of the heads in C k C_{k} for image-2 query positions, leaving values, other heads, and all other positions untouched. Transplant runs the base model with these rows taken from the trained model on the same input; the recovered fraction is its accuracy gain over base divided by g g . Restore runs the trained model with these rows taken from the base model; the removed fraction is its accuracy loss divided by g g . Each operation is repeated on five layer-matched random head sets. The frozen criteria call a head set sufficient (or necessary ) if the recovered (or removed) fraction is at least 0.25 0.25 , its numerator is positive under the bootstrap, and it exceeds all five random sets. The decisive case is arm D, which never targeted C k C_{k} .

blocks.en: An attention row depends on the head’s query–key weights and on the residual stream it reads. We split Transplant accordingly. Upstream computes the rows of C k C_{k} with the base model’s query–key weights applied to the trained model’s inputs. Local applies the trained weights to the base model’s inputs. Each set of rows is then transplanted into the base model as before (Table 18 ). For D on SP , Upstream recovers .282 .282 [ .207 .207 , .348 .348 ] of the gain in Qwen3-VL-8B and .233 .233 [ .166 .166 , .298 .298 ] in InternVL3.5-8B , 83 % 83\% and 86 % 86\% of the full transplant measured in the same run, whereas Local recovers .043 .043 and .035 .035 with intervals reaching zero, and the interaction is near zero. E and the HP items show the same ordering, and no random head set recovers more than 7.4 % 7.4\% of the gain on SP under any operation. The all-layer adapter thus routes its gain through the comparison heads not by rewriting them but by changing what they read: the heads’ own weights, applied to better inputs, already produce most of the transplanted effect.

blocks.en: The improvement that an unconstrained adapter learns contains, as one of its parts, a change in how the comparison heads attend across images; this part alone carries a third to a half of the gain in Qwen3-VL-8B , and it is produced upstream of the heads: the change in their own query–key weights contributes little on its own. The trained models also carry the improvement through other routes, which compensate when the comparison heads are reset. The targeted repair is carried by the comparison heads; the unconstrained repair uses them but does not depend on them. The comparison heads are thus a sufficient but redundant pathway: a point through which gradient descent repairs semantic correspondence on its own, but not a bottleneck through which every repair must pass.

blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: For exact copies, the comparison succeeds—selectivity is high and the answer position carries the result—but the output does not use it: neither calibration nor amplifying the decoded signal recovers it. For semantic correspondence, the visual tokens carry the correspondence, but the cross-image heads compare reference and candidates only weakly, the base model’s semantic answers barely depend on them, and the result does not reach the answer position. Same-instance correspondence lies in between and is largely solved. The repair experiments close the loop for the semantic case: changing only the similarity computed by the comparison heads recovers most of the deficit, raises their selectivity, and transfers to unseen correspondence benchmarks; and training that is free to change anything still changes these heads’ attention, by changing what they read, in a way that is sufficient to reproduce a large share of its gain. Training turns heads that the base model does not use for semantic correspondence into a route for it.
blocks.zh: 对于准确的拷贝,比较成功——选择性高而回答位置带有结果——但输出不使用:既不校正也不放大解码信号恢复. 对于语义学的函证,可视符号会携带函证,但交叉相像头比较参考而考生只微弱,基础模型的语义学答案几乎不依赖于它们,结果没有达到答案位置. 同仁书信位于两者之间并基本被解决. 修补实验关闭了语义学案例的循环:仅改变比较头所计算的相似性就能恢复大部分的赤字,提高它们的选择性,并转移到隐形的函证基准上;可以随意改变任何事物的培训仍然通过改变它们所读的东西来改变这些头的注意力,以足以重现它们的大部分收益。 训练将基础模型不用于语义通信的头部变成了它的路线.

blocks.en: Large gaps measured with annotated-region readouts are reproduced by our privileged readouts, but on real correspondence they reflect information that the language model does not bring to the answer, rather than an answer that is computed and withheld. This picture does not depend on whether the entities can be named. It agrees with the observation that perceptual information inside the language model often goes unused ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and it adds the step at which this happens for cross-image tasks and a component that can be trained to change it. Like gaze heads for single-image description ( Gandikota and Bau, 2026 ) , the comparison heads are a small set whose attention controls what reaches the answer; unlike them, they compare across images, and they are a sufficient but redundant route rather than a unique one.
blocks.zh: 与附加说明的区域读取量相比,差距很大,这是我们特权的读取量所复制的,但是,在真正的通信中,这些读取量反映的是,语言模式并没有给答案带来信息,而不是一个计算和拒绝的答案。 此图不取决于实体是否可以命名 。 它同意以下观点:语言模型内的感知信息经常被使用(Fu等人,2025;Liu等人,2025),它增加了跨图像任务发生的步骤和可以被训练来改变的组件. 与凝视单相像描述(Gandikota and Bau, 2026)一样,相像头是一组小片,它的注意力控制着到达答案的事物;与它们不同的是,它们相互比较图像,它们是一个足够但冗余的路线,而不是独特的路线.

blocks.en: A query–key update can only change which existing features the heads match. Sharpening the same heads does not help, while learning their similarity does, so the comparison function is a limiting factor. The parameter-matched all-layer adapter also changes the features themselves and the path from the comparison to the answer; that it outperforms the targeted arm, and that restoring the comparison heads inside it removes little of its gain, both indicate that the comparison is one of several limiting steps. The decomposition of § 6.3 makes the first point concrete: the part of D’s gain that passes through C k C_{k} comes from changed inputs to the heads, which no update of the heads’ own projections can produce. A practical consequence is that the comparison heads are a good diagnostic for repairs—their selectivity tracks accuracy across every arm we trained—even where they are not the most efficient target.

blocks.en: Three practical points follow. First, the locus decides where a remedy must act: for exact copies the comparison is already computed, so the target is how the answer is read out, where neither calibration nor single-layer amplification suffices; for semantic correspondence the target is the comparison itself, and that is where training succeeds. Second, the comparison heads are an inexpensive training target: about 0.02 % 0.02\% of the parameters, + 19 +19 to + 24 ​ p ​ p +24\,pp on SP from only 500 training items, and transfer to benchmarks never used for training or selection. Third, because broad fine-tuning routes a third to a half of its SP gain through the same heads in Qwen3-VL-8B , their selectivity offers a way to inspect what a fine-tuned model has changed, without retraining or probing.
blocks.zh: 下面是三个实际要点。 首先,地点决定补救办法必须在哪里行动:对于准确的拷贝,比较已经计算出来,所以目标就是如何读出答案,因为校准或单层放大都不够;对于语义对应来说,目标就是比较本身,也就是培训成功的地方。 其次,比较头是一个费用低廉的培训目标:大约0.02%的参数,+19+19至+24页的SP上只有500个培训项目,转而使用从未用于培训或选择的基准。 第三,由于它的SP增益的三分之一到一半通过Qune3-VL-8B的同种头来进行广泛的微调,它们的选择性提供了一种检查微调模型改变的方法,没有再培训和检测.

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Input-matched, calibration-controlled measurement shows that the representation–output gap in cross-image correspondence is not a property of unnameable entities. Exact-copy matching is computed and lost at readout; semantic correspondence is encoded in visual tokens but only weakly compared by a small set of salience-gated, content-selective cross-image heads. Training only these heads recovers most of the semantic-correspondence deficit and transfers to other benchmarks, and broad adapters route part of their gain through them by changing what they read: the comparison heads are a sufficient but redundant pathway for repair. Locating the loss in this way separates what a model sees from what it compares and from what it says. It turns that separation into a small, verifiable target for training and gives a cheap readout, the selectivity of a fixed head set, for checking what fine-tuning has changed.
blocks.zh: 输入相匹配、校正相控的测量表明,跨图像函文中的表示-输出差距不是无法命名的实体的财产。 精确的拷贝匹配在读取时被计算并丢失;语义对应被编码为可视符号,但只被一小组显要的,内容选择的交叉相像头所弱取. 只有这些头部的培训能够恢复大部分语义-对应性缺陷和转移到其他基准,并且通过改变它们读取的内容来从宽的适配器路径中获取部分收益:比较头部是一个足够但多余的修复路径. 以这种方式分配损失,将模型所看到的与其所比较的和所讲的区分开来. 它将这种分离变成一个小的,可核查的训练目标,并提供一个廉价的读取,固定头集的选择性,用于检查微调的改变.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Mechanistic results and repairs cover two families at the 8B scale; Gemma-3-12B enters the measurement results only. Blocking the attention of C k C_{k} leaves the natural residual-norm range for about half of the Qwen3-VL-8B synthetic items; the mass-preserving knockouts keep 94 94 – 98 % 98\% of Syn items in range, but on HP 6 6 – 16 % 16\% of items leave it ( 21 % 21\% under Block ), although restricting to in-range items leaves the drops nearly unchanged. In the base models, knocking out C k C_{k} has little effect on SP , so causal evidence for semantic correspondence comes from the trained models. The attention-matched control heads are not layer-matched, and three of their four learning-rate sweeps selected the largest rate of the grid, as did A in InternVL3.5-8B (A Q reuses A’s rate in both models). Attention mass describes where heads look; causal evidence comes from knockouts and transplants. Markers make the reference salient by design; the decoy-marker experiment addresses this, but natural queries specify the reference in other ways. The targeted repair is below the parameter-matched all-layer adapter, and in InternVL3.5-8B it lowers accuracy on both synthetic conditions, which the all-layer adapter does not. Answer-position edits show that the probe’s direction is not the one the output reads, while the output direction of each letter at the same layer is; they do not identify the channel through which the comparison is lost. SOCO could not be evaluated; the BLINK splits contain fewer than 200 items each, so their intervals are wide. Synthetic results use one stimulus family and one answer format per model, and the answer format differs from the prefill used by Shahgir et al. (2026) , so absolute accuracies are not directly comparable to theirs. Natural extensions include head sets matched to C k C_{k} in layer and attention mass at once, and general-capability evaluations after targeted repair.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work analyses publicly released models on public or synthetic data. The adapters improve a perceptual capability on a narrow task family and introduce no new capability class. Head-targeted training changes model behaviour in ways that general evaluations may not reveal, as the synthetic-task drop under the targeted InternVL3.5-8B adapter shows; any such repair should be evaluated for unintended effects on unrelated behaviour before deployment.
blocks.zh: 这项工作分析了公开发布的公共或合成数据模型。 适配器提高了狭义任务家族的知觉能力,没有引入新的能力类. 针对头的培训改变模式行为,其方式一般评价可能无法揭示,因为针对对象的InternVL3.5-8B适配器下的合成任务下降;在部署之前,应评估任何此类修复对无关行为的意外影响。

blocks.en: Every number in the main text was recomputed from raw per-item outputs, or, for probe and calibration refits, checked against stored per-item values, by scripts that do not import the experiment code, with no mismatches (between 238 and 3.6 × 10 5 3.6\times 10^{5} checks per run). Per-item answer-position calibration and probe refits used in the fresh-item confirmation were asserted to reproduce the earlier per-item values before any forward pass. Region-to-token mappings were validated with a perturbation test at the patch-embedding output; for InternVL3.5, the pixel footprint of each region was defined from the support of the resize kernel. Item sets for the fresh-item confirmation use seeds, sequences, and image pairs disjoint from all earlier runs, except that most HP image pairs recur with new reference points and distractors. Repair test pairs are disjoint from all earlier runs, and overlap between training, validation, and test splits was checked by pair identifier.
